  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

* [ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy gold seal] Learn more
  
  ### ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy
  
  Optum Infusion Pharmacy is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC) for
  pharmacy services backed by rigorous quality standards. This designation recognizes our commitment
  to safety, accuracy and improved health outcomes.
  
  [View infusion services][72]
* [NABP Accredited Digital Pharmacy seal] Learn more
  
  ### NABP – Digital Pharmacy
  
  Optum Pharmacy is proud to be a National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) Accredited
  Digital Pharmacy. This independent, third-party verification demonstrates how our operations meet
  the highest standards for patients who count on convenient, reliable and safe online pharmacy
  services. 
  
  [View pharmacy services][73]

  dedication to formulary decision-making grounded in safety, efficacy and therapeutic need;
  transparent financial disclosures and continuous quality improvement.
  
  [View PBM solutions][74]

  ### NCQA – Utilization Management

  decision-making by utilization professionals, built on a framework of continuous quality
  improvement. 
  
  [View PBM solutions][75]

  practices — helping keep members healthier while reducing unnecessary costs.
  
  [View solutions][76]

#### Margin Pressures

Shifting payer mix and value-based payment models, changing consumer behaviors, rising labor costs
and market consolidation create competing priorities.

#### Technology & Virtualization

Embracing emerging technologies can expand a Provider’s capacity to engage patients, support
clinicians, enhance efficiencies and improve revenues.

#### Workforce Optimization

Aligning specialized, best-cost located work teams with industry expertise and quality-focused
processes can accelerate financial, clinical and patient outcomes.

#### Anticipating the Next Normal

Prioritizing investments that advance care outside the clinical setting to address the widening
inequities, evolving regulations and rising cost of healthcare.

## Overcome Healthcare’s Softening Revenues and Rising Expenses

#### Margin Pressures

Shifting payer mix and value-based payment models, changing consumer behaviors, rising labor costs
and market consolidation create competing priorities.

#### Technology & Virtualization

Embracing emerging technologies can expand a Provider’s capacity to engage patients, support
clinicians, enhance efficiencies and improve revenues.

#### Workforce Optimization

Aligning specialized, best-cost located work teams with industry expertise and quality-focused
processes can accelerate financial, clinical and patient outcomes.

#### Anticipating the Next Normal

Prioritizing investments that advance care outside the clinical setting to address the widening
inequities, evolving regulations and rising cost of healthcare.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Your mission. Made real.

The pressure on healthcare leaders is relentless. That’s exactly why we’re here. 

[Talk to an expert][12][Find your solution][13]

## Healthcare is under siege. When your mission is on the line, ours is too.  

We enable providers to deliver better, more affordable care by improving financial sustainability,
enhancing system performance and accelerating strategic growth. 

[We are built differently — and that difference is everything ]

Why healthcare leaders choose us

## We are built differently — and that difference is everything 

Solving the hardest challenges in healthcare doesn't happen in isolation — and it doesn't happen
with a vendor. It happens with a partner who brings intelligence you can act on, expertise that has
lived your challenges, solutions that span your entire enterprise, and a network of the most
influential leaders in healthcare. That's Vizient. 

## Better healthcare doesn't happen by accident. It demands bold thinking.

Innovation at Vizient isn't a product or a platform. It's a relentless drive to change how care gets
delivered.

# The Healthcare Revenue OS for real-time adjudication

[ Revenue architecture Explore our new architecture for revenue ][20]
Our Beliefs

## We’re creating a new era in revenue cycle management driven by three core beliefs.

( 1 )

### Comprehensive automation is the future.

We believe in system level automation, powered by AI agents and orchestrated across the entire
revenue cycle.
( 2 )

### A system-level view is essential.

Effective automation requires a connected, contextual understanding of the full revenue cycle
ecosystem.
( 3 )

### Real-time adjudication is within reach.

AI makes it possible to align payer and provider incentives, resolve claims instantly and eliminate
administrative drag.
Introducing

## Phare: Healthcare’s First Revenue Operating System

* ### Our agentic approach
  
  Phare is a platform that automates complex work through an integrated agentic system.
* ### Orchestration
  
  Orchestration agents seamlessly route and pass work between specialist AI agents and humans across
  the revenue cycle with a system level approach.
* ### Embedded expertise
  
  Specialist AI agents are trained on historical decisions, actions and outcome data, embedding two
  decades of revenue cycle expertise in every action.
* ### Compliant. Human-supported
  
  Built on R1’s AI governance framework to provide guardrails for data usage, compliance and
  transparency, with expert human oversight and supervision.
* ### Continuous learning and improvement
  
  Phare captures and evaluates decisions, actions and outcomes in a self-learning process that
  improves performance over time.
* ### Data foundation
  
  20 years of decisions, actions and outcomes inform our agentic approach, with 280m transactions
  each year guiding decision-making.

### Operating partnerships

A longer term engagement where R1 manages revenue cycle operations and employees, leveraging our two

( 2 )

### Agentic solutions

Expert R1 engineers partner with customers to integrate, implement and curate AI agents, maximizing

R1's AI Lab

## R37 is building technology that’s transforming the unit economics of healthcare.

[R37 web image v2]

## An innovation engine

R37 is R1’s AI lab to transform healthcare financial performance. Our dedicated team of
technologists and revenue cycle experts identify, build and scale AI solutions aimed at achieving
comprehensive automation and moving the industry to real-time adjudication.

We utilize reasoning, language, voice and capture use models to build AI agents that are deployed as
part of an integrated system. This system optimally allocates work between autonomous agents and
humans. The results are increased revenue, reduced costs and faster throughput.

## The AI Platform for Regulated Customer Operations

Acclaim combines **human-quality voice AI, configurable compliance guardrails, and enterprise
deployment flexibility** to power modern customer operations and experience for regulated
industries.

Hear it Now[ Contact Us][17]
[Acclaim dashboard]

## What Is The Acclaim Platform?

Our AI CX platform doesn’t make you choose between AI innovation and delighting customers at scale
vs. ensuring your data is safe and compliant — **you get to have both**. This is how we’ve done it
from day one:

### AI You Control Inside Your Environment

Acclaim runs on-prem or in your private cloud, so your data, models, and conversation records are
stored with complete data sovereignty. That’s crucial in banking and other highly regulated
industries.
* On-prem or private cloud deployment by default
* Data, model weights, and logs stay in your environment
* Open, modular architecture with no black-box dependency
* Auditability and policy control built into every interaction
* Built for regulated environments with strict data and compliance requirements

### Goal-Driven AI, Not Open-Ended Conversation

Most AI agents are built to follow prompts; Acclaim agents are built to achieve actual business
outcomes within defined guardrails that positively impact your bottom line.
* Goal-Oriented Agent Logic (GOAL) aligned to defined outcomes
* Flexible conversation paths with controlled boundaries
* Human-quality voice with near-zero latency
* Real-time adaptation to context, interruptions, and intent
* Multilingual and omnichannel by design

### Operate With Ease

Acclaim is built for the teams that have to run it. Launch priority use cases quickly, test before
going live, and expand at your own pace with full visibility and control.
* Start with one use case and expand over time
* Self-service Agent Studio for building and managing agents
* Simulate and test before launch
* Turn workflows on or off as business volume changes
* Full visibility into the data and logic shaping agent behavior

## AI-Powered Recovery, Powered By Acclaim

See how **[Overtime][18] **uses the Acclaim platform to automate compliant payment outreach and
scale AI-powered recovery workflows across industries.

### For First-Party Collections Teams

**Extend in-house recovery capacity without hiring.**
* Scale empathetic collections without growing headcount
* Adapt conversations in real time toward resolution
* Increase promises-to-pay and follow-through rates
* Capture every interaction with full audit visibility

### For Agencies & Debt Buyers

**Maximize yield while stabilizing cost-to-collect.**
* Launch compliant outreach campaigns in minutes
* Handle high-volume portfolios with consistent performance
* Optimize recovery strategies across account segments
* Improve collector efficiency while lowering operational cost

### For Healthcare Revenue Cycle Organizations

**Improve patient recovery with scalable compliant engagement.**
* Automate patient payment outreach at scale
* Reduce missed follow-ups and payment delays
* Guide patients through flexible payment options
* Improve recovery performance with compliant conversations

[ Explore Overtime][19]

### What is the Acclaim platform?

business tasks across channels, with banking and fintech as the lead implementation.

You can launch an initial high-impact use case in weeks, not months, depending on integration scope
and deployment model. Deployment typically begins with a focused workflow and essential system
integrations, followed by a controlled pilot. Once validated, additional scenarios and channels can
be added.

### How does Acclaim support compliance in regulated industries?

Acclaim is built for regulated environments and includes guardrails that enforce approved scripts,
policies, and workflow constraints within every interaction. GOAL-oriented scenario logic ensures
conversations stay within defined business rules, while full audit logs provide visibility into what
was said, what decisions were made, and which systems were accessed.

requirements, and its modular architecture allows integration with internal compliance systems,
monitoring tools, and reporting frameworks.

in-app deployments, and messaging/text where it improves completion (for example, capturing
names/emails or selecting time slots).

operational control are required.

strategy, with results available in analytics and exportable reports. It can be delivered as managed
private cloud (Stage 1) and later as multi-tenant self-service SaaS (Stage 2).

resolving issues, and booking appointments) to build and train voice-first AI agents with your team
so they’re completely customized to your systems, processes, and knowledge.

## Why Healthcare Organizations Lose Revenue They've Already Earned

Provider Enrollment & Credentialing

Get your providers credentialed and enrolled with every payer that matters, faster and with fewer
gaps. We centralize provider records, manage payer applications, track expirations, and keep your
revenue moving by making sure your providers are ready to bill from day one.

[Learn More][76]

Patient Access

Clean front-end data prevents the denials no amount of follow-up can recover. We verify eligibility,
capture accurate demographics, and confirm benefits before the visit, so charges flow without
friction and your team starts each encounter with the information they need.

[Learn More][77]

Prior Authorization, Eligibility & Benefit Verification

Authorizations stall revenue and tie up clinical staff. We submit, track, and document every
authorization in one workflow, catching expirations before they catch you. Status visibility
prevents the silent failures that turn into denied claims and missed care.

[Learn More][78]

Medical Coding

Coding accuracy is where revenue is won or lost. Our certified coders work every encounter with
rule-based validation built into the workflow, so charges move from documentation to clean claim
with fewer keystrokes, fewer errors, and faster turnaround at the payer.

[Learn More][79]

Medical Billing

Billing is where everything upstream finally produces revenue. Coded encounters become scrubbed
claims. Scrubbed claims become payer submissions. Payer submissions become posted payments.

[Learn More][80]

Accounts Receivable Follow-Up

Aged AR is recoverable if someone is working it the right way. Our team works receivables by
priority, payer, and recovery probability, surfacing what is collectible, what is at risk, and what
needs escalation, so effort lands where it pays back fastest.

[Learn More][81]

Denial Management

Denials are signal, not noise. We track them by payer, reason, and dollar value to identify patterns
over time, then build appeals from templates refined across thousands of cases. The result is faster
recoveries on current denials and fewer new ones going forward.

[Learn More][82]

Coding Audits

Audit findings should not be surprises. We audit coding accuracy against payer rules and
documentation, flagging issues before they become rejections. Patterns surface across providers and
visit types, turning audits into training and protecting you from compliance exposure.

[Learn More][83]

Contract Negotiations

Most practices accept payer rates without ever benchmarking them. We analyze your payer mix,
identify under-market contracts, and negotiate from a position of evidence, so the rates you accept
reflect the value you deliver and the leverage you have not been using.

[Learn More][84]

RCM Consulting

We analyze performance across the revenue cycle to identify operational gaps and implement
strategies that improve cash flow, strengthen margins, and support scalable growth.

[Learn More][85]

Every node connects to every other. This is what providers navigate daily.

The revenue cycle is where clinical work gets converted into payment. When it breaks down, the loss
is silent. Claims age past recovery. Denials stack up without follow-through. Providers sit
unenrolled while authorization requests pile up unanswered.

None of it shows up on a patient chart. All of it shows up on a balance sheet.

  Lost annually to billing inefficiencies across U.S. healthcare
* 42%
  
  Of collectible revenue lost to preventable denials and coding errors
* 100+
  
  Days average A/R aging when revenue cycle management breaks down

None of those numbers are fixed. They are what happens when revenue cycle management is fragmented,
split across vendors, managed reactively or handled in-house without the infrastructure to do it
right. The problems are solvable. Most organizations just have not had one team accountable for
solving all of them.

The revenue cycle is where clinical work gets converted into payment. When it breaks down, the loss
is silent. Claims age past recovery. Denials stack up without follow-through. Providers sit
unenrolled while authorization requests pile up unanswered.

None of it shows up on a patient chart. All of it shows up on a balance sheet.
* $3.7 Billion
  
  Lost annually to billing inefficiencies across U.S. healthcare
* 42%
  
  Of collectible revenue lost to preventable denials and coding errors
* 100+
  
  Days average A/R aging when revenue cycle management breaks down

None of those numbers are fixed. They are what happens when revenue cycle management is fragmented,
split across vendors, managed reactively or handled in-house without the infrastructure to do it
right. The problems are solvable. Most organizations just have not had one team accountable for
solving all of them.

HOW WE WORK

## The Nine Services Inside a
## Complete Revenue Cycle Management Program

Most outsourced revenue cycle management companies handle part of the cycle. Advantum owns the
entire cycle. One team. One contract. When something is not working, there is one call to make.
* ### Provider Enrollment & Credentialing
  
  Get providers credentialed faster. Stay compliant longer.
  
  CredentialSync Automation
  
  Every provider must be enrolled with every payer before a single claim can be submitted. Errors at
  this stage do not surface immediately, they appear months later as denied claims, delayed
  reimbursements, and compliance flags. We centralize provider records, manage payer applications,
  track expirations, and keep your revenue moving by making sure your providers are ready to bill
  from day one.
  * Initial enrollment and re-credentialing
  * Payer application management
  * Expiration tracking and alerts
  * Managed care contract organization
  
  [ Learn More ][86]
* ### Patient Access
  
  Revenue integrity starts at the front door.
  
  AccessPoint Automation
  
  The denial that lands six weeks from now was created at the front desk today. Clean front-end data
  is the single biggest lever in preventing the denials no amount of follow-up can recover. We
  verify eligibility, capture accurate demographics, and confirm benefits before the visit so
  charges flow without friction.
  * Eligibility verification
  * Demographics and intake capture
  * Benefits confirmation
  * Pre-visit financial clearance
  
  [ Learn More ][87]
* ### Prior Authorization, Eligibility & Benefit Verification
  
  Stop losing revenue before treatment even begins.
  
  AuthVerify Automation
  
  Authorizations stall revenue and tie up clinical staff, and the rules change faster than most
  teams can absorb. Missed authorizations do not show up at the time of service, they appear weeks
  later as denials with no appeal path. We submit, track, and document every authorization in one
  workflow, catching expirations before they catch you.
  * Auth submission and tracking
  * Expiration monitoring
  * Payer-specific workflow management
  * Documentation and audit trail
  
  [ Learn More ][88]
* ### Medical Coding
  
  Accurate coding. Clean claims. Fair reimbursement.
  
  CodeAssist Automation
  
  Coding is where revenue is captured, lost, or quietly leaked. A single incorrect modifier or
  documentation gap does not surface in the same week, it surfaces in your aged AR report and your
  denial trends. Our certified coders work every encounter with rule-based validation built into the
  workflow, moving charges from documentation to clean claim with fewer errors and faster
  turnaround.
  * Certified coding across specialties
  * Rule-based claim scrubbing
  * Claims submission and tracking
  * Documentation review
  
  [ Learn More ][89]

## Help Center – Get the Answers You Need

## Your Questions, Clearly Answered

Our Help Center is designed to provide clear, concise, and reliable answers to the most common
inquiries about our services, processes, and support. Whether you’re a healthcare provider exploring
outsourcing solutions or an existing client seeking assistance, you’ll find valuable information to
guide you every step of the way.

Are Your Medical Billing Services HIPAA Compliant?

Yes, we comply with HIPAA regulations. As HIPAA codified the use of ICD codes for diagnosis and CPT
and HCPCS codes for procedural reporting, we follow and monitor the standardization of medical codes
used by coders and billers.

Why Is A/R Follow-Up Important?

A/R follow-up enables all hospitals, physicians, nursing homes, and other organizations to recover
past-due payments quickly and easily. It is easier for healthcare providers to obtain reimbursements
on time when a team streamline the claims follow-up procedure.

Is Patient Information Kept Confidential?

Absolutely. The patient's medical information provided to us will not be disclosed to anyone unless
the patient grants their authorization to do so.

How Do You Ensure Regulatory Compliance?

We stay updated on
1. Keep up with regulatory developments.
2. Ensure that your personnel understand the significance of compliance.
3. Connect the security staff and the law for proper understanding.
4. Use appropriate tools to continuously monitor compliance.

How Do I Start Outsourcing to Allzone?

Once patient data or information, including insurance verification, is detailed in a format that
allows the claim for healthcare services to be processed, the medical billing team validates the
patient's insurance precisely end-to-end and moves on to the next procedure.

What Makes Allzone Different?

Our team of professionals combine their knowledge to tailor our outsource healthcare management
services to your practice's exact needs for specialities and software systems.

## Help Center – Get the Answers You Need

## Your Questions, Clearly Answered

Our Help Center is designed to provide clear, concise, and reliable answers to the most common
inquiries about our services, processes, and support. Whether you’re a healthcare provider exploring
outsourcing solutions or an existing client seeking assistance, you’ll find valuable information to
guide you every step of the way.

Are Your Medical Billing Services HIPAA Compliant?

Yes, we comply with HIPAA regulations. As HIPAA codified the use of ICD codes for diagnosis and CPT
and HCPCS codes for procedural reporting, we follow and monitor the standardization of medical codes
used by coders and billers.

Why Is A/R Follow-Up Important?

A/R follow-up enables all hospitals, physicians, nursing homes, and other organizations to recover
past-due payments quickly and easily. It is easier for healthcare providers to obtain reimbursements
on time when a team streamline the claims follow-up procedure.

Is Patient Information Kept Confidential?

Absolutely. The patient's medical information provided to us will not be disclosed to anyone unless
the patient grants their authorization to do so.

How Do You Ensure Regulatory Compliance?

We stay updated on
1. Keep up with regulatory developments.
2. Ensure that your personnel understand the significance of compliance.
3. Connect the security staff and the law for proper understanding.
4. Use appropriate tools to continuously monitor compliance.

How Do I Start Outsourcing to Allzone?

Once patient data or information, including insurance verification, is detailed in a format that
allows the claim for healthcare services to be processed, the medical billing team validates the
patient's insurance precisely end-to-end and moves on to the next procedure.

What Makes Allzone Different?

Our team of professionals combine their knowledge to tailor our outsource healthcare management
services to your practice's exact needs for specialities and software systems.

# Your Revenue Cycle Partner

# for Stellar Results  

Powered by technology and focused on patients, our solutions transform your healthcare revenue cycle
into a well-oiled machine.

We hold ourselves accountable to deliver consistently stellar results.

We do this through our world-class team, our sophisticated technology, and our personlized focus on
patients and clients.

[Our Story][19]

Our Approach

## Personalized Service Driven by Patient-centricity, Innovative Technology, and Proven Processes

Our Solutions

## Patient-focused and Tech Powered Revenue Cycle Solutions 

Our offerings are never one-size fits all. We meet your organization where it is to optimize
revenue, improve security, ensure compliance, and enhance business excellence. Each healthcare
billing solution prioritizes patient experience. Our services span medical specialties and billing
platforms.

End-To-End Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

Our end-to-end healthcare revenue cycle solutions are powered by exceptional technology and a
patient-centered team. We help our clients maximize revenue and enhance patient experience.

Customized Solutions

Leverage our suite of stellar, a la carte RCM solutions for medical practices, ranging from coding
only and AR management, to worker’s compensation and auto claim management and advisory services.

[Learn More][20]

Our Priority

## Serving You and Your Patients with Precision

Healthcare RCM is critically important in keeping people and businesses healthy. We approach RCM
differently by prioritizing people and focusing on the fundamentals when solving your most complex
RCM challenges. Our sophisticated technology and culture empower our team to care for your patients.
The result: improved patient experience and exceptional results for your organization.

[Working to solve a customer problem together]

## Exceptional RCM Results

We transform revenue cycles into well-oiled machines, and our partners choose us because we
continually deliver.

Our Team

## Inspired Humans, Healthcare Revenue Cycle Experts

We believe the not-so-secret ingredients to exceptional RCM results are outstanding people,
innovative technology, and a positive, collaborative work environment. Our company is unique in the
healthcare revenue cycle management space because we actively seek out service-oriented team members
who care about patients. Are you looking for an inspiring new role with an encouraging team? Learn
more about our exceptional culture and the way we support our people.

[Explore Careers in the U.S.][21]
[Explore Careers in India][22]

*Allyson Cohan, Director of Revenue Integrity and Compliance*

Consistently Stellar Performance

## We Improve Key Revenue Cycle Metrics, Every Time 

Whatever your RCM needs, our tech-powered solutions and personalized focus help cut costs,
streamline processes, and identify sources of coding errors and denials to optimize future
collections. We dig in to pinpoint core issues in your revenue cycle and put processes in place to
increase cash flow and reduce lost revenue.

Our partners experience:

Why Arietis Health

## Our Team Personalizes Proven Processes to Transform your RCM

Our partners appreciate our extensive healthcare expertise, sophisticated technology, and our focus
on patients. Choose Arietis for:

Exceptional technology and data analytics

100% transparency and real-time access to your data

Agnostic solutions for any specialty

Guaranteed increase in collections and reduction in denials

RCM solutions customized to fit the unique nuances of your organization

Adam Spiegel, CEO

# Unlock Revenue. Maximize Cashflow. Minimize Risk. 

Aspirion helps hospitals unlock revenue from denied and complex claims—without the operational
burden. From clinical denials to out-of-network reimbursement to zero-balance review, we turn
financial dead-ends into revenue.

Our US-based attorneys, clinicians, and AI engineers use proprietary AI to turn your hospital’s RCM
challenges into recovered revenue. With more than $6 billion captured for providers nationwide, your
hospital could be next.

[Let's Talk Complex RCM][27]

## Partnership Powered by Excellence

Recovery Impact

LEADING THE WAY

## Solutions to Maximize Your Revenue

[Aspirion's Services]

### Our Intelligent RCM Services Suite

###### **Revenue Integrity**
* [Accounts Receivable (AR) Management][28]
* [Denials Management][29]
* [Out-of-Network Recovery][30]
* [Payment Variance Recovery][31]

###### **Complex Claims  ****  **
* [Motor Vehicle Accident][32]
* [Out-of-State Medicaid][33]
* [Veterans Affairs-TRICARE][34]
* [Workers’ Compensation][35]

[Our Services][36]

## Technology Built to Power Our Team

Behind every dollar we recover is [technology built in-house][37] to find it. Compass, our workflow
automation platform, integrates with your EHR. Our AI platforms—**DocIQ, ClinIQ, and
ContractIQ**—layer on the intelligence, giving our team the evidence to win at scale.

**Compass** routes each claim. **DocIQ** pulls cited clinical evidence from medical records with
99.7% accuracy. **ClinIQ** turns denial outcomes into insights that strengthen documentation to
improve overturn rates. **ContractIQ** models payer contracts to find and recover underpayments.

Together, they give our team the accuracy and speed manual processes can’t touch. The best part? We
only succeed when you do.

[Let's Talk Complex RCM][38]
[The Power Behind Our Solutions]

## Let’s Be Great Together

[2025 Best in KLAS Denials Management]
[2024 Best in KLAS Denials Management Services]
[2022 Best in KLAS]
[r2 HITRUST Certified]

Our commitment to excellence hasn’t gone unnoticed—we’ve earned the 2024 & 2025 [Best in KLAS award
for Denials Management][39] and achieved [HITRUST r2 certification][40] for the third consecutive
cycle.

**But we’re not stopping there.** We’re constantly investing in cutting-edge technology and expert
talent to push revenue cycle management forward. Why? Because we believe you should get paid
accurately, quickly, and transparently—so you can stop worrying about your bottom line and focus on
patient care.

**What are you waiting for? Let’s be great together.**

## Contact Us

Find out how Aspirion’s Revenue Cycle Management services will optimize your reimbursements.

# Healthcare is Powered by Availity

The #1 trusted healthcare network—where more than half of U.S. healthcare transactions run, and
where healthcare technology partners build and scale innovation at national scale.

[ Explore Solutions ][123]

### Where the network comes to life

Across eligibility, authorizations, claims, and payments, Availity supports the work that keeps
healthcare moving every day, at national scale – powering the workflows that your products depend on
and connect into.

For Providers

Streamlined workflows, secure, reliable connectivity & world-class customer support ensure revenue
cycle success

•   Margin and yield improvement
•   Reduced denials and write-offs
•   Accelerated cash flow
•   Reduced labor burnout

[ Learn More ][124]

For Payers

Multi-channel provider engagement, API-first connectivity & industry-leading approach to
cybersecurity

•   Accelerated digital adoption
•   Right data, right time
•   Improved precision and reduced waste
•   Deeper network insights

[ Learn More ][125]

For HITs

Nationwide healthcare connectivity & connected capabilities enable innovation at scale

**•   **National all‑payer and all‑provider reach 
**•   **Proven clearinghouse and transaction backbone
**• **APIs and agent-ready activation designed to scale across healthcare

[ Learn More ][126]

### Powering the Leaders of Healthcare

From providers to payers to HITs, industry leaders trust Availity to power mission-critical
connectivity and innovation. Click on a logo to explore their results.

### Availity is Where Healthcare Connects

As the nation’s largest dual-sided, real-time healthcare network, Availity brings unparalleled scale
& reach

**Direct Payer Connectivity**

**Connected Providers**

**Connected B2B Partners**

**in Billed Claims Annually**

### Providers, payers & HITs look to Availity for…

**Collaboration
**Leverage Availity as a neutral third party to align industry stakeholders and solve pervasive
problems

**Network reach
**Connect with payers, providers and HITs nationwide through Availity’s real-time health information
network

**Dual-sided innovation
**Reduce friction and drive behavior change with solutions that deliver shared value for payers and
providers

**Intelligent workflows
**Leverage Availity’s AI-enabled platform to automate and transform complex payer/provider workflows

**Unified admin & clinical data
**Improve care & financial outcomes by integrating administrative and clinical data into key
workflows

**Improved accuracy
**“Shift left” to proactively resolve issues upstream by to eliminate costly rework
and lost value 

Market-leading digital payer/provider collaboration platform

Delivering innovative solutions for complex payer/provider engagement & workflow automation 

Support end-to-end healthcare transactions – from eligibility, authorizations, claims, remittances
and beyond
Unify administrative, clinical and financial workflows across the healthcare ecosystem
Provide unparalleled extensibility, insight and value through a single technology foundation
Drive transparency, accuracy and speed across the healthcare continuum
Leverage the Availity network to accelerate innovation at scale

### Availity is Built for Better 

**Fragmented data. Manual processes. Rising costs. Slow approvals.**

For too long, these challenges have made it harder for healthcare to move at the speed patients
need.

At Availity, we believe healthcare delivery should be better: more connected, more intelligent, and
more seamless for everyone. Watch how we’re helping bring payers, providers and HIT vendors together
to reduce friction and move healthcare forward.

Cardamom is an EHR professional services firm and multidisciplinary team of data, analytics, AI, and
application experts. Leveraging our team-based approach, we help healthcare leaders solve complex IT
and operational challenges across the entire healthcare organization from patient engagement to
value-based care, revenue cycle optimization, EHR application support, and beyond.

[ Contact Us ][21]

What Cardamom Does

### Cardamom offers flexible support and creative solutions to solve your most significant
### organizational challenges.

As the healthcare landscape continues to evolve, organizations are constantly balancing strategic
initiatives with ongoing maintenance and daily support. Time-sensitive requests and system
inefficiencies continue to overwhelm IT teams as patient outcomes, employee satisfaction, and
financial implications are on the line.

The next evolution of health care requires flexible, agile teams to deliver high-tech, results-based
solutions and support across [data][22], [analytics][23], and [EHR applications][24].

Using Cardamom’s team-based approach, our in-house technical and operational experts can help you
get the most from your IT investments, stabilize and reduce IT costs, and optimize access to data to
create actionable insights, ultimately driving improved quality, financial, and patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][25]
How we help

[Services]

 

Who we help

[ [Northeast Georgia Health System] ][30]
[ [Sharp HealthCare] ][31]

Cardamom's Flexible AI Services

### Making meaningful and lasting impact in healthcare outcomes by using AI.

With rising costs and shrinking revenues, healthcare organizations are under growing pressure to do
more with less. At the same time, they're being tasked with adopting emerging technologies like AI
to drive long-term transformation.

By mobilizing your current data, analytics, and applications, Cardamom can find practical and
impactful ways to incorporate AI holistically into your current workstreams, helping you make the
most of your existing technologies.

[ AI Services ][32]
[ai_800x800]
[ms_rootcause_800x800]

Cardamom's Approach to Managed Services

### Transforming health IT with root-cause resolution and results-based support.

Leveraging our AI-enhanced managed services approach, we can take [data][33], [analytics][34],
and [application][35] support and maintenance off your plate at any scale — from the fractional,
specialized needs of niche applications to enterprise EHR support — with committed service level
agreements and root-cause issue resolution. Shifting your team away from routine tasks allows for
increased focus on higher-value work and more strategic projects, such as [AI][36] and automation,
to help you reach your organizational goals.

For customers with shorter-term needs, our team can also provide fixed-fee, outcome-based support to
give you extra bandwidth for in-flight projects, take on new initiatives, or provide expertise to
set future projects up for success.

[ Managed Services Solutions ][37]

Cardamom's Revenue Cycle Optimization Expertise

### Empowering your organization to achieve optimal revenue cycle outcomes.

Healthcare provider organizations are continuously confronted with a myriad of obstacles — from
improving operational margins to navigating intricate government regulations and meeting the demands
of both payers and consumers.

A strategic approach to [revenue cycle optimization][38] that integrates data, utilizes
industry-leading technology, and streamlines EHR workflows can effectively address these
complexities, resulting in enhanced operational efficiency, improved consumer experiences, and
increased value from existing technology investments.

[ Revenue Cycle Optimization Solutions ][39]
[revcycle_800x800]
[VBC]

Cardamom + Value-Based Care

### Accelerating your shift to value-based care.

Healthcare providers are challenged to deliver better quality care while also containing costs. This
transition toward value-based healthcare continues to gain momentum.

Successful [value-based care][40] initiatives rely on actionable insights derived from robust,
multi-source data. The seamless integration of data, advanced analytical tools, and optimized EHR
workflows allow

**Frequently Asked Questions** Your queries answered
What is ExpiredDomains.com?
ExpiredDomains.com is a free online platform that helps users find valuable expired and expiring
domain names. It aggregates domain data from hundreds of top-level domains (TLDs) and displays them
in a searchable, filterable format. Whether you’re seeking domains with SEO authority, existing
traffic, or strong brand potential, the platform provides tools and insights to support smarter
decisions.
Is there a cost to use the platform?
No, the platform is completely free to use. You can browse listings, view metrics, and apply filters
without needing to sign up or pay any fees. There are no hidden charges or usage restrictions.
Can I register domains directly through the site?
No, ExpiredDomains.com does not register domains itself. Instead, it connects you to trusted
external registrars and marketplaces like GoDaddy. You’ll be directed to complete your purchase or
place a bid through their platform.
How often is the domain data updated?
The domain data is updated daily to ensure you're always seeing the most current listings, prices,
and metrics. This includes newly expired domains, auction updates, and fresh insights from
third-party tools and proprietary systems.
What tools and filters are available on the platform?
You can filter domains by TLD, keyword, length, backlink profile, SEO score, traffic estimates, and
more. The platform also includes proprietary metrics like Estimated Auction Price, BrandRank, and
SEO Price, alongside trusted data from sources like MOZ and Majestic.

**Frequently Asked Questions** Your queries answered
What is ExpiredDomains.com?
ExpiredDomains.com is a free online platform that helps users find valuable expired and expiring
domain names. It aggregates domain data from hundreds of top-level domains (TLDs) and displays them
in a searchable, filterable format. Whether you’re seeking domains with SEO authority, existing
traffic, or strong brand potential, the platform provides tools and insights to support smarter
decisions.
Is there a cost to use the platform?
No, the platform is completely free to use. You can browse listings, view metrics, and apply filters
without needing to sign up or pay any fees. There are no hidden charges or usage restrictions.
Can I register domains directly through the site?
No, ExpiredDomains.com does not register domains itself. Instead, it connects you to trusted
external registrars and marketplaces like GoDaddy. You’ll be directed to complete your purchase or
place a bid through their platform.
How often is the domain data updated?
The domain data is updated daily to ensure you're always seeing the most current listings, prices,
and metrics. This includes newly expired domains, auction updates, and fresh insights from
third-party tools and proprietary systems.
What tools and filters are available on the platform?
You can filter domains by TLD, keyword, length, backlink profile, SEO score, traffic estimates, and
more. The platform also includes proprietary metrics like Estimated Auction Price, BrandRank, and
SEO Price, alongside trusted data from sources like MOZ and Majestic.
